local_visual_review_notes: Viewed both RTX front/rear captures in attempt 000008: dark textured single leaf, frame, lever handles and hinge fittings retained. Fitted clearances and idealized hinge graphics are adequate for closed-unlatched pushing.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Attempt 000008 passes static and isolated RTX 4090 physics at the geometry-derived 113.1-degree stop. Correct fixed-pin axis and opening side (left handed under a proper rotation); four reviewed internal hinge contact pairs filtered, with all leaf/frame/handle and external hinge collisions retained. No further scaling or tolerance relaxation; robot/expert qualification pending.
